exercises.title: 7. Pratique: Concessive clauses — however, albeit, notwithstanding

items.prompt: ___ useful the framework may be, it cannot capture every cultural nuance.
items.hintAfterError: Conector concessivo + adjetivo: 'por mais útil que seja'. Começa com H.

items.prompt: The proposal was accepted, ___ reluctantly, by the Singapore office.
items.hintAfterError: Conector formal de 6 letras usado antes de advérbio ou adjetivo, sem verbo.

items.prompt: ___ the language barrier, the teams built strong working relationships.
items.hintAfterError: Antes de um substantivo, sem verbo, o conector precisa funcionar como preposição.

items.prompt: ___ clearly James explained the policy, it was still misinterpreted in Mumbai.
The meeting was productive, ___ shorter than expected.
